translations.web: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’
translations.bsb: And now what are you waiting for? Get up, be baptized, and wash your sins away, calling on His name.’
translations.kjv: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
translations.asv: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on his name.
